quests.title: Those Hard-to-Reach Places

dialogue.t: Oh, what am I to do...

dialogue.sit: Do you need help with anything?

dialogue.t: Whenever the Windblume Festival rolls along, people will always offer up all manner of flowers to the Archon statue. Then a gust of wind comes, and off they go, flying every which way.

We've had to spend no small amount of effort to clear these withered flowers out. But while I can handle the flowers and leaves in the plaza itself, there's not much I can do about the ones that get onto roofs and the city walls.
Definitely not with these knees of mine. They really aren't holding up well...
You would? Oh, that's wonderful. Those withered flowers are pretty obvious. You should be able to see them the moment you get on top of a roof.
*sigh* More steps here, and a couple of roofs there, up and down, up and down... I don't know how long my knees will last at this rate...
Huh, guess there really was a cat. Wonder why it's over here...
Meow... Meeeow...
Meow-meow!
Um, hate to break it to you, but Paimon doesn't think it understands a thing you just said...
Let's get it down from here first. Maybe Aramis knows who it belongs to.
I'm sorry, I don't think I've seen it. If I did, I'm sure I would have had some impression.
Oh, I see... That little darling really loves flowers. I thought that she might have chased them here.
Meow... Meow!
Is that... Butterfly? Oh, it really is you! Where have you been?
So it's just as I thought, then... Thank you so much. Butterfly here loves to chase flowers. She's been a real headache during this time, what with there being flowers all over the city and all.
Thank you once again — your next drink's on me the next time you visit The Cat's Tail. Well, the non-alcoholic ones, at least.

dialogue.sit: Let's save that tab for next time, I suppose.

dialogue.t: Haha... Once again, thank you. See you around, and happy Windblume Festival.
Well, I never — so cats are attracted to the flowers too. What a busy festival... Still, it's good that you found that cat.
If you'd asked me to climb up there to rescue it, I'm afraid my knees would have given up the ghost...
Well then, thank you for your trouble. Here's a little something for your work.

quests.description: Knight of Favonius Aramis is worried about the flower petals blowing all over the place…
